inputs.prompt: Make one coherent full-color fantasy game illustration, a single wide scene, not a reference board. Keep the two women unmistakably different: black hair and navy-red samurai outfit on the left; copper hair and burgundy mage outfit on the right. Place both characters naturally inside an empty moonlit stone courtyard with a ruined bridge and distant arched gate; keep the architecture behind them and visible around their silhouettes. Eye-level medium-wide camera, natural relaxed stance, faces readable, no overlapping bodies, no duplicate people, no extra panels, no borders, no labels, no text, no watermark.
